sentences.en: You'd be surprised what you can learn in a week.
sentences.zh: 你可能会惊讶于一周内你能学到的东西。

sentences.en: We work on every day of the week except Sunday.
sentences.zh: 除了周日我们每天都工作。

sentences.en: We bargained that we should go on a five-day week.
sentences.zh: 我们讨价还价后决定实行五天工作制。

senses.zh: 一星期，周,工作周（一个星期中的工作时间）
